entries.text: Notable Changes Fixed Fixed NewProviders failing with a resource schema conflict when used with OpenTelemetry SDK v1.45.0. The resource containing service.name no longer specifies a schema URL, allowing it to inherit the default resource's schema. Security Updated OpenTelemetry to v1.47.0 to fix an attribute length limit bypass and excessive memory allocation when parsing baggage.

entries.summary: Experimental: Store and retrieve operations now respect ExternalStorage.Concurrency; Experimental: Custom BucketFunc callbacks can now run concurrently for different payloads within a single Store call. Synchronize any…
entries.text: Notable Changes Changed Experimental: Store and retrieve operations now respect ExternalStorage.Concurrency. Experimental: Custom BucketFunc callbacks can now run concurrently for different payloads within a single Store call. Synchronize any shared state the callback accesses. Experimental: Payloads stored with no target are now written under v0/ns/{namespace}/d/sha256/{hash}, using the namespace of the client or worker (null when it is unknown), instead of v0/d/sha256/{hash}. Object names for payloads with a target are unchanged, and existing objects remain retrievable. 💥 Breaking Changes Raised the minimum Temporal Go SDK requirement from v1.49.0 to v1.52.0, which provides StorageDriverStoreContext.Namespace.

entries.summary: Workflows can inspect cancellation causes with workflow.Cause and cancel local contexts with workflow.WithCancelCause. Reasons supplied through client.CancelWorkflowWithOptions or the new…
entries.text: Notable Changes Added Workflows can inspect cancellation causes with workflow.Cause and cancel local contexts with workflow.WithCancelCause. Reasons supplied through client.CancelWorkflowWithOptions or the new workflow.RequestCancelExternalWorkflowWithOptions are available as cancellation causes inside the target workflow. Context.Err() continues to return workflow.ErrCanceled. External- and child-workflow cancellation requests inherit the context's cause when no nonempty reason is supplied. internalbindings.WorkflowEnvironment exposes GetCancellationReason and reason parameters on child- and external-workflow cancellation requests for SDKs built on top of the Go SDK. Experimental: converter.StorageDriverStoreContext and converter.StorageDriverSelectContext have a Namespace field holding the namespace of the client or worker performing the operation, so drivers and selectors can partition by namespace even when there is no Target. Experimental: Added worker.GetInfo, which returns a snapshot of a worker's state, currently its task slot usage. Changed Reduced gRPC interceptor allocations when the effective metrics handler is a no-op. converter.NewZlibCodec reuses zlib writers and readers across payloads instead of creating them for every payload. A writer is about 1 MB of allocation, so encoding allocates far less, which reduces garbage collection in workers that encode many payloads. The encoded output is unchanged.
